image_description: A close-up macro shot of a single, large soap bubble. The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling patterns of cyan, magenta, yellow, and green caused by thin-film interference. The surface is highly reflective and glossy, showing distorted reflections of the surrounding environment (likely trees or foliage) on its curved surface. The background is a soft, out-of-focus gray/brown bokeh.
